changes.title: Pet Care, Commercial
changes.summary:
New use and standard.
M-1 to M-4, CL, CG, LI: X -> P
changes.quote: No veterinary care, overnight kenneling, or onsite kenneling is permitted.

changes.title: Cigar Lounge
changes.summary:
New use and standard.
M-1 to M-4, CL, CG, LI, AA: X -> S
changes.quote: Cigar lounges may not be located within 1,000 feet of another cigar lounge.

changes.title: Kitchen
changes.summary:
New accessory use and standard.
M-2, M-3: X -> A
changes.quote: Kitchen facilities may be permitted only as accessory uses within a Residence Hotel.

changes.title: Kitchenette
changes.summary:
New accessory use and standard.
M-1 to M-4, CL, CG, LI, AA: X -> A
changes.quote: Kitchenette facilities may be permitted only as accessory uses within a Hotel, Full Service or Hotel, Limited Service.

changes.title: Medical Clinic
changes.summary: New limit in M-1, M-2, and M-3. Also adds an enclosed-structure rule and no retail pharmacies in LI.
changes.quote: Medical clinic facilities shall not exceed 5,000 square feet GFA.

changes.title: Hookah Bar
changes.summary: Rewritten with new spacing, closing-time, and inspection rules. The late-hours request in the special use permit application is gone.
changes.quote: Hookah bars must be located in a stand-alone building.

changes.title: Urban Agriculture, Noncommercial
changes.summary: Fowl limit now applies to more than three fowl (was three or more).
changes.quote: to keep or harbor more than three fowl

changes.title: Warehouse or Wholesale Facility
changes.quote: Warehouse uses shall be no more than 75% of the warehouse or wholesale facility GFA.

changes.title: Hookah bar
changes.summary: M-1 to M-4, CL, AA: S -> X

changes.title: Retail sales, more than 50,000 sq. ft. GFA
